column1: # It Takes Two on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Hazelight / Electronic Arts, Unreal Engine 4 with NVN, Switch version 1.0.2 (v131072).
# Tested on the OPPO OPD2409 (SM8750P, Android 17): the full game, all chapters, with the alpha13
# runtime; 60 fps target. The title, the opening, the hub and the chapters play; saves and chapter
# selection work. The known remaining issues are the sRGB window-surface fallback and alias stale reads.
# The two hot host threads on the Snapdragon 8 Elite prime cores (CPU 6/7), the other cores left to the
# workers. This is a profile default; the app also writes the same rows for an already-installed pack.
